enum.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_ACTION
enum.description: Action requested by an FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET message.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_ACTION_CONTROL
entry.description: Apply all four motor values with the supplied timeout.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_ACTION_RELEASE
entry.description: Release actuator-test control for all four motors.

enum.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS
enum.description: Result of validating and queueing one four-motor set.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_ACCEPTED
entry.description: All four actuator-test entries were accepted and queued.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_RELEASED
entry.description: Release entries for all four motors were queued.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_REJECTED_VALUE
entry.description: At least one motor value was non-finite or outside the permitted range.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_REJECTED_TIMEOUT
entry.description: The requested timeout was outside the permitted range.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_REJECTED_UNSAFE
entry.description: The vehicle state did not permit actuator testing.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_REJECTED_SEQUENCE
entry.description: The sequence number was duplicated or older than the accepted sequence.

entry.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_STATUS_REJECTED_RUN
entry.description: The run identifier was zero, expired, released, killed, or did not start at sequence zero.

message.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET
message.description: One atomic four-motor actuator-test request generated by the onboard FFTGYRO experiment executor.
message.field: Non-zero identifier generated once for each executor run.
Monotonically increasing set number, starting at zero for a new run.
PX4 actuator-test timeout. CONTROL permits 50 through 500 ms.
System ID of the target autopilot.
Component ID of the target autopilot.

message.name: FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET_ACK
message.description: Acceptance or rejection of one FFTGYRO_MOTOR_SET. ACCEPTED means queued, not physically emitted by DShot.
message.field: PX4 monotonic time at which the set was validated.
Run identifier copied from the request.
System ID of the executor that sent the request.
Component ID of the executor that sent the request.
